title: Mysterious pill-shaped UFO caught on camera by pilots flying above Middle America
description: Pilots flying over Ohio contacted air traffic control after spotting a strange object near their plane, only to be told nothing was registering on radar. An account posted to the National UFO Reporting Center (NUFORC) on October 26 described a silver, pill-shaped UFO that appeared almost stationary as the aircraft approached. One pilot captured a photograph of the object, which he described during a follow-up interview with NUFORC investigator Ben Hansen.
